# Original behavioral inputs

All content is original and synthetic. `existing.svg` supplies an intentionally
settled small design. `continuation.md` is a supplied prior-session note, not
proof that an agent previously performed that session. `INCOMPLETE.json` and
`older-export.txt` explicitly describe a synthetic interrupted-export starting
condition; they are never counted as a fault-injection run or an actual PNG.
`imperfect.png` is a deliberately tiny original 24-by-16-pixel color grid for
selected realistic-image revisions, not a photograph or visual truth source.

The manifest's expected observations and judgment questions are evaluator input.
The harness exposes only the task and supplied input files to the producer.
Model-generated outputs are retained privately and reviewed separately; these
static inputs and harness tests cannot establish model behavior.
